summary.text: Jess Branas is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 97 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Steven Mentzer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a public educator who had worked as a district director for a state representative and had served as an elected council member.

paragraphs.text: Jess Branas graduated from Manheim Township High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Pittsburgh in 1999, and earned a graduate degree from Millersville University in 2012.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in Lancaster County, returned to Lancaster in 2025 to help with her aging parents, and lives in East Lampeter.
She said she holds a master's degree in Spanish from Millersville University and works as a public educator.
Branas said in the survey that she had been the District Director for a State Representative and had served as an elected council member after winning a seat that had been held by the other party.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

Branas listed utility and housing costs, access to affordable health care, public education and career opportunities, and the regulation of artificial intelligence and AI data centers as her main issues.
